== Acquisition ==

* [[Xu Fengxia]] ([[Ran Musu Gardens]])
* [[Michiko]] ([[Kaineng Center]])

== Related skills ==
* {{skill icon|Summon Spirits}}

== Hero Usage ==

* Heroes appear to focus on moving [[Restoration Magic]] spirits faster than others.
* Outside of combat, heroes use this skill inconsistently (even when allied spirits are available) and wait until they are at the edge of Draw Spirit's range to do so. They will not use it on their own while under a speed boost.

== Notes ==
* If not targeting a specific spirit, this causes nearest allied spirit to shadow step to your location.
* Teleporting a spirit to your location while another allied spirit of the same name is within [[spirit range]] will cause the shadow-stepped spirit to die.

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.

{{Bug|Contrary to the description, this skill causes the spirit to [[shadow step]] rather than [[teleport]].}}
